stories.title: Mother Design drew with a psychic's guide before designing the Purple Garden identity
stories.blurb: For the psychic services platform, the team ran a chakra reading and an automatic drawing and writing workshop with a Purple Garden practitioner, then built the identity from the resulting marks and textures. The workshop stood in for a brand audit: the designers wanted to experience the service themselves before making anything for its audience.

stories.title: Elmwood brought Dolmio's puppet family back by writing rules for each character
stories.blurb: Elmwood's Kyle Whybrow says each puppet got principles, behaviours and visual codes, and the family was built into Dolmio's red dot system so it sits inside the graphic language rather than on top of it. The aim was to change enough to avoid a tribute act and not so much that it breaks the bond with the characters.

sources.headline: "Nostalgia is a double-edged sword": how Dolmio revived its beloved puppet family for a new generation

stories.title: Rockstar art-directed every GTA 6 passer-by instead of generating the crowd
stories.blurb: According to an Edge cover feature, a dedicated LA team of writers, directors and producers shaped the game's pedestrians, around 600,000 animations in total. Each NPC carries personality traits that govern how it reacts to the player. The author reads it as a deliberate bet on raising the ceiling, where procedural crowds only raise the floor.
